description: This Java class 'IterateSectionWidget' is part of the OFBiz widget model, responsible for rendering sections of a widget with support for pagination, iterating over lists or maps, and rendering nested sections.

classes.name: IterateSectionWidget
classes.description: A widget class for rendering sections of a widget with support for list iteration and pagination within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getSectionList
methods.description: Returns the list of sections within this widget.

methods.name: renderWidgetString
methods.description: Renders the widget as a string, iterating over list/map data, rendering nested sections, and handling pagination.

methods.name: getPaginateTarget
methods.description: Returns the target for pagination links, expanded from the context.

methods.name: getPaginate
methods.description: Determines whether pagination is enabled based on the context and configuration.

methods.name: getViewSize
methods.description: Returns the configured view size for pagination.

methods.name: renderNextPrev
methods.description: Renders the pagination navigation links (next/previous) based on current view index and size.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor for processing this widget.
